newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle sales light at $69 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle sales light at $69 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow, with no slaughter steer sales confirmed, slaughter heifers steady to firm, USDA said. Inquiry and demand moderate.

Feedlots very current. Sales confirmed on 600 slaughter heifers Thursday. For the week to date 88,000 head confirmed including 15,200 head or about 17 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle. Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1000 lbs 69.00. Confirmed - 600
